# CentringAdda

> CentringAdda (https://centringadda.online/) is a free centring (centering) and steel cost calculator and contractor marketplace for Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It estimates slab, beam and column shuttering labour, steel centring material hire and Fe500 reinforcement steel, and connects builders with verified centring mestris and shuttering material suppliers. Rates are indicative, excluding GST. Office: Hitech City, Hyderabad 500081. Phone/WhatsApp: +919948680017.

Estimate slab, beam and column shuttering labour, MS plate and prop hire and Fe500 steel per sq.ft. Find verified centring mestris and suppliers.

## Key facts
- With the calculator's built-in default rates (zone factor ×1.08, individual house), a sample job of 1200 sq.ft slab, 80 RFT beam, 12 columns and 21 days of hire comes to about ₹7,91,207 excluding GST, roughly ₹659 per sq.ft including steel. Live rates and your own inputs will change this.
- Also known as: centring, centering, shuttering, formwork, mestri, maistry, mistri.
- Languages: English and Telugu (తెలుగు).
